pages.title: Young Anna From Frozen Riding Her Bicycle Through the Castle Hallway Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows young Anna from Frozen riding a bicycle through a castle hallway, with braids, a front basket, and training wheels. Tall arched windows, framed portraits, and a suit of armor line the corridor, while the bicycle's curved frame and wheels add smaller sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frozen 2 Queen Anna Unveiling the Statue of Her Parents in Arendelle Coloring Page
pages.description: Queen Anna unveils the statue of her parents in Arendelle on this printable coloring page, wearing a crown and holding the unveiling rope. The fallen covering drapes beside the pedestal, with a castle tower and mountains behind the figures. Long gown and cape sections contrast with the smaller crown and uniform details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frozen Anna in Forest Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Anna from Frozen in a forest clearing, with two braids, a patterned cape, and gloves beneath arching tree branches. Her large portrait fills most of the coloring sheet, leaving broad sections in the cape and dress alongside smaller leaf motifs, braid segments, and the decorative clasp at her collar.

pages.title: Frozen Anna in Holiday Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Anna waves in a holiday village on this printable coloring page, wearing a decorated dress and cape beside snowy houses and ornamented evergreen trees. Holly leaves and snowflake decorations surround her braided hairstyle, while falling snowflakes fill the sky. This coloring sheet combines wide skirt sections with small ornaments, boot patterns, and floral details.

pages.title: Frozen Anna in Palace Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Anna from Frozen in a palace garden, standing beneath a flower-covered arch with her hands together and twin braids. Flowers and leafy vines frame her cape and patterned dress, with shrubs and a low wall behind her. Broad clothing sections alternate with small petals and leaves throughout this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frozen Anna in Magical Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Anna stands in a magical forest on this printable coloring page, wearing twin braids and a cape fastened with a large snowflake-shaped clasp. Curving tree trunks, scattered leaves, and small star-like shapes surround her portrait. This coloring sheet has open cape panels and finer enclosed patterns on the bodice, braids, and surrounding plants.

pages.title: Frozen Anna in Wind Spirit Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Anna in a wind spirit meadow, with flowing hair, a braided crown, and loose leaves swirling around her shoulders. Flowers and leafy stems rise along the hillside behind her patterned outfit. The coloring sheet pairs broad sleeve and skirt sections with small buttons, embroidered-looking motifs, and curved wind lines.

pages.title: Frozen Anna in Winter Market Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Anna from Frozen in a winter market, wearing earmuffs, braids, and gloves between stalls backed by steep-roofed village houses. A lantern, pretzels, stacked boxes, and bunting give the market distinct details. Her decorated cape and skirt provide larger sections among the smaller items and architectural lines on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frozen Anna on Rocky Shore Coloring Page
pages.description: Anna stands on a rocky shore in this printable coloring page, wearing a long cape and patterned dress beside water and distant snow-capped mountains. Rounded shoreline rocks frame her boots, and small wave lines cross the open water. This coloring sheet leaves generous spaces in the sky, cape, and skirt around the finer braid and bodice details.

pages.title: Frozen Anna in Snowy Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Anna from Frozen in a snowy meadow, with bow-tied braids, a clasped cape, and falling snowflakes around her smiling face. Snow-covered evergreen trees and low shrubs form a sparse background. Wide clothing panels make up much of this coloring sheet, balanced by curled bodice patterns and small snowflake shapes.

pages.title: Frozen Anna in Ice Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Anna inside an ice palace, standing beneath a pointed arch decorated with crystals and a large circular snowflake emblem. Icicles hang around the doorway behind her braids and cape, while she holds her hands near her waist. This coloring sheet combines long gown panels with angular crystal shapes and small bodice patterns.
